messages:
alex: Planning terraform apply for release/2.5.0: adding cross-AZ peering and pin aws_vpc module to v3.2.1 to avoid regression. Change window 2026-04-02 22:00-01:00 PT. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/642
maria: noted. why full pin vs a patch? any tests failing on v3.3.x?
alex: staging showed route overlap on v3.3.0; pin to v3.2.1 is safest for the release. we'll unpin after upstream fixes.
deploy-bot: terraform plan succeeded for release/2.5.0 branch
```
+ aws_vpc_peering_connection.peering
~ aws_route.route_table (2 mods)
+ aws_iam_role.peering_link_role
```
No destroys.
sre-oncall: suggest canary apply to prod-staging account (us-west-2a/b) then full. add rollback steps to runbook.
dave: I'll be on-call for the window. I can verify routes and BGP/propagation. if >3 modified routes abort.
alex: runbook: 1) canary apply 22:00 2) validate peering ACTIVE on both sides 3) check route uniqueness and propagation 4) full apply 22:30 5) if error revert PR and re-apply previous commit
maria: approved. include CIDR collision checklist and quick revert commands in runbook.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary apply 2026-04-02T22:00:00-07:00 (rdw-apply-20260402-01)
deploy-bot: canary apply started by alex (rdw-apply-20260402-01)
deploy-bot: Apply complete. 2 added, 1 changed, 0 destroyed. peering pcx-0f2e3d4c5b. route checks OK.
sre-oncall: canary verified ACTIVE and propagating. no issues. proceeding to full in 30.
alex: starting full apply now
deploy-bot: full apply started (rdw-apply-20260402-02)
deploy-bot: ERROR: aws_route.route_table create failed in account-prod-5: RouteAlreadyExists. Full apply aborted.
maria: initiating rollback: revert PR 642 and re-apply commit ab12cde (previous module ref). who's running?
dave: running revert apply (rdw-apply-20260402-03)
deploy-bot: revert apply complete. State reconciled. 1 added, 2 changed, 0 destroyed.
sre-oncall: routes back to previous state, no customer impact. marking resolved.
alex: for release notes: pinned aws_vpc module to v3.2.1 temporarily; canary succeeded, full failed due to duplicate route in prod account. follow-up ticket for dedupe automation and module compatibility tests: https://jira.internal/browse/INFRA-2199
maria: will pair with platform team on route dedupe automation and add test in CI to detect RouteAlreadyExists before apply.
dave: recommend a pre-check script to query existing routes and fail fast.
alex: thanks. scheduling retry next week after dedupe fixes. closing thread.
